name: tea-coffee-master
description: 商用与专业级奶茶、果茶、咖啡研发与制作大师 v3.0（动态联网拆解新品 + BOM成本组装 + 降本/低卡/摆摊极速优化 + 自进化引擎）。内置可执行CLI精算引擎、爆款连锁配方库与交互式吧台SOP生成器。
description_zh: 商用与专业级奶茶、果茶、咖啡研发与制作大师 v3.0（动态联网拆解新品 + BOM成本组装 + 降本/低卡/摆摊极速优化 + 自进化引擎）。内置可执行CLI精算与联网引擎(scripts/beverage_engine.py)、爆款连锁结构化配方库(data/beverages_db.json)与交互式吧台SOP生成器。
description_en: Commercial Milk Tea, Fruit Tea, and Specialty Coffee Formulation & BOM Costing Expert Plugin (v3.0). Features a dynamic closed-loop CLI engine for live chain-brand drink teardown fetching, 500ml/700ml ml/g standardization, BOM cost & delivery margin calculation, and interactive HTML barista portal generation.

displayName.zh: 商用茶饮与精品咖啡研发总监

profession.zh: 茶饮咖啡研发与BOM精算专家

displayDescription.en: Live chain-brand beverage teardown, 500ml/700ml commercial SOP formulation, single-cup BOM cost & delivery platform margin calculation, supply-chain cost reduction, and 15-second street-stall workflow optimization.
displayDescription.zh: 支持全网实时拆解霸王茶姬/喜茶/瑞幸/古茗等当季新品配方、自动标准化为500ml/700ml冷热双版商用克重(ml/g)、精准核算单杯BOM成本与美团/饿了么扣点净利、一键执行【供应链平替降本/0糖低卡改造/夜市15秒极速出杯SOP重构】，直出可贴墙打印的交互式吧台SOP系统。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我联网拆解霸王茶姬新品『晴山栖谷』的500ml商用复刻配方，核算单杯BOM成本与毛利率，并给出高毛利供应链平替方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Fetch and reverse-engineer the 500ml commercial formula for Chagee's new drink 'Qingshan Xigu', calculate single-cup BOM cost and gross margin, and provide a supply-chain cost-reduction plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我联网拆解霸王茶姬新品『晴山栖谷』的500ml商用复刻配方，并做高毛利供应链平替。
quickPrompts.en: Reverse-engineer Chagee's 'Qingshan Xigu' 500ml commercial formula and optimize for higher gross margin.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想在夜市摆摊卖『手打暴打柠檬茶』和『生椰拿铁』，请给我100杯备料采购清单与15秒极速出杯SOP。
quickPrompts.en: Provide a 100-cup batch prep list and 15-second street-stall SOP for Hand-Smashed Lemon Tea and Coconut Latte.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我核算『杨枝甘露』定价16元、美团外卖扣点22%、日销150杯时的真实净利率与回本周期。
quickPrompts.en: Calculate the net profit margin and payback period for Mango Pomelo Sago at 16 CNY with 22% delivery platform fee and 150 cups/day.

quickPrompts.zh: 如何制作不分层、不苦涩的『橙C冰美式』和防絮凝的『柠檬轻乳茶』？请给出精确ml/g配比与萃茶参数。
quickPrompts.en: How to make non-bitter Orange Iced Americano and curdling-free Lemon Milk Tea? Provide exact ml/g ratios and brewing parameters.
